<h1 id="openapi-spec-for-clickhouse-cloud-organization">Organization</h1>

## Get list of available organizations

<a id="opIdorganizationGetList"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.clickhouse.cloud/v1/organizations \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /v1/organizations`

Returns the organizations available to the caller, oldest first. An API key resolves to the single organization it belongs to; a user token returns every organization the user is a member of. Results are capped at `limit` (default 250) per page; the server may return fewer and caps the value at its own maximum. Every response carries `limit` and `nextCursor`; pass `nextCursor` as the `cursor` query parameter to fetch the next page, repeating until it is null.

<h3 id="get-list-of-available-organizations-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|limit|query|integer|false|Maximum number of results to return.|
|cursor|query|string|false|Opaque cursor from a previous response's `nextCursor`, marking where to resume the list.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "status": 200,
  "requestId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
  "result": [
    {
      "id": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
      "createdAt": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "name": "string",
      "privateEndpoints": [
        {
          "id": "string",
          "description": "string",
          "cloudProvider": "gcp",
          "region": "ap-northeast-1"
        }
      ],
      "byocConfig": [
        {
          "id": "string",
          "state": "infra-ready",
          "accountId": "123456789012",
          "accountName": "string",
          "regionId": "ap-northeast-1",
          "cloudProvider": "gcp",
          "displayName": "string"
        }
      ],
      "enableCoreDumps": true,
      "capabilities": {
        "snapshots": true
      }
    }
  ],
  "limit": 0,
  "nextCursor": "string"
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "status": 400,
  "error": "string",
  "requestId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
}
```

> 500 Response

```json
{
  "status": 500,
  "error": "string",
  "requestId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
}
```

## Update organization details

<a id="opIdorganizationUpdate"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.clickhouse.cloud/v1/organizations/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08 \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d '{
    "name": "string",
    "privateEndpoints": {
      "add": [
        {
          "id": "string",
          "description": "string",
          "cloudProvider": "gcp",
          "region": "ap-northeast-1"
        }
      ],
      "remove": [
        {
          "id": "string",
          "description": "string",
          "cloudProvider": "gcp",
          "region": "ap-northeast-1"
        }
      ]
    },
    "enableCoreDumps": true
  }'
```

`PATCH /v1/organizations/{organizationId}`

Updates organization fields. Requires ADMIN auth key role.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "name": "string",
  "privateEndpoints": {
    "add": [
      {
        "id": "string",
        "description": "string",
        "cloudProvider": "gcp",
        "region": "ap-northeast-1"
      }
    ],
    "remove": [
      {
        "id": "string",
        "description": "string",
        "cloudProvider": "gcp",
        "region": "ap-northeast-1"
      }
    ]
  },
  "enableCoreDumps": true
}
```

<h3 id="update-organization-details-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organizationId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the organization to update.|
|body|body|[OrganizationPatchRequest](#schemaorganizationpatchrequest)|false|none|
|» name|body|string|false|Name of the organization.|
|» privateEndpoints|body|[OrganizationPrivateEndpointsPatch](#schemaorganizationprivateendpointspatch)|false|none|
|» enableCoreDumps|body|boolean|false|Whether crash reports (core dumps) collection is enabled for services in the organization. When disabled at the organization level, individual services cannot enable crash reports.|

## Get organization quotas

<a id="opIdorganizationQuotasGetList"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.clickhouse.cloud/v1/organizations/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/quotas \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/quotas`

**Disclaimer:** This beta endpoint is evolving; the API contract may change. <br /><br /> Returns the resource quotas enforced for the organization together with their current usage where available. Quotas that do not apply to the organization are omitted. Quota values reflect the limits currently enforced, so they can be polled to detect changes, for example after a billing status change. The response contains one entry per quota code; quotas enforced per resource may additionally appear under resource-scoped endpoints in the future.

<h3 id="get-organization-quotas-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organizationId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the requested organization.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "status": 200,
  "requestId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
  "result": [
    {
      "quotaCode": "services-per-organization",
      "name": "Services per organization",
      "description": "string",
      "scope": "organization",
      "value": 20,
      "usage": 3,
      "adjustable": true
    }
  ]
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "status": 400,
  "error": "string",
  "requestId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"

```

> 500 Response


`POST /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/byocInfrastructure`

Create a new BYOC Infrastructure in the organization. Returns the configuration of the newly created infrastructure

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "regionId": "ap-northeast-1",
  "accountId": "123456789012",
  "availabilityZoneSuffixes": [
    "a"
  ],
  "vpcCidrRange": "10.0.0.0/16",
  "externalId": "ch-0a1b2c3d4e5f6789",
  "tenantId": "string",
  "servicePrincipalClientId": "string",
  "vpcId": "vpc-0abc1234def567890",
  "privateSubnetIds": [
    "string"
  ],
  "publicSubnetIds": [
    "string"
  ],
  "gcpPodCidrRangeNames": [
    "string"
  ],
  "gcpSharedVpcHostProjectId": "string",
  "tags": {
    "property1": "string",
    "property2": "string"
  },
  "displayName": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="create-byoc-infrastructure-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organizationId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the requested organization.|
|body|body|[ByocInfrastructurePostRequest](#schemabyocinfrastructurepostrequest)|false|none|
|» regionId|body|string|true|Region in which the BYOC infrastructure will be located|
|» accountId|body|string|true|Cloud account ID the BYOC infrastructure is configured for: AWS account ID, GCP project ID, or Azure subscription ID|
|» availabilityZoneSuffixes|body|[string]|false|List of availability zone suffixes|
|» vpcCidrRange|body|string|false|CIDR range for the ClickHouse-managed VPC. Mutually exclusive with the BYO-VPC fields (`vpcId`, `privateSubnetIds`, `publicSubnetIds`)|
|» externalId|body|string|false|AWS only: ExternalID baked into the ClickHouse management role trust policy in your account|
|» tenantId|body|string|false|Azure only (required for Azure regions): Entra tenant ID of the subscription|
|» servicePrincipalClientId|body|string|false|Azure only (required for Azure regions): client ID of the service principal ClickHouse uses to manage the infrastructure|
|» vpcId|body|string|false|BYO-VPC only (AWS and GCP): ID or network name of the customer-provided VPC to deploy into. Requires `privateSubnetIds`|
|» privateSubnetIds|body|[string]|false|BYO-VPC only: private subnet IDs or names (1-6 entries on AWS, exactly one on GCP)|
|» publicSubnetIds|body|[string]|false|AWS BYO-VPC only: public subnet IDs (at most 6 entries)|
|» gcpPodCidrRangeNames|body|[string]|false|GCP BYO-VPC only: secondary IP range names on the subnet to use for pod IPs. Omitted: all secondary ranges are used|
|» gcpSharedVpcHostProjectId|body|string|false|GCP BYO-VPC only: Shared VPC host project owning the VPC and subnet, when different from `accountId`|
|» tags|body|[ByocInfrastructureTags](#schemabyocinfrastructuretags)|false|none|
|» displayName|body|string|false|Human readable name for infrastructure|

`POST /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/byocInfrastructure/validate`

**Disclaimer:** This beta endpoint is evolving; the API contract may change. <br /><br /> Preflight-validates that a cloud account is ready for BYOC infrastructure creation: simulates the cloud permissions ClickHouse needs (and, for BYO-VPC, checks the provided network resources) without creating anything. Takes the same parameters as infrastructure creation, so a payload that passes validation will not be rejected by create for the same inputs.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "regionId": "ap-northeast-1",
  "accountId": "123456789012",
  "availabilityZoneSuffixes": [
    "a"
  ],
  "vpcCidrRange": "10.0.0.0/16",
  "externalId": "ch-0a1b2c3d4e5f6789",
  "tenantId": "string",
  "servicePrincipalClientId": "string",
  "vpcId": "vpc-0abc1234def567890",
  "privateSubnetIds": [
    "string"
  ],
  "publicSubnetIds": [
    "string"
  ],
  "gcpPodCidrRangeNames": [
    "string"
  ],
  "gcpSharedVpcHostProjectId": "string",
  "tags": {

}
```

## Update BYOC Infrastructure

<a id="opIdorganizationByocInfrastructureUpdate"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.clickhouse.cloud/v1/organizations/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/byocInfrastructure/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08 \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d '{
    "displayName": "string",
    "enablePrivateLink": true,
    "gcpPscSubnetId": "string",
    "enablePrivateLoadBalancer": true,
    "enablePublicLoadBalancer": true,
    "tags": {
      "property1": "string",
      "property2": "string"
    }
  }'
```

`PATCH /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/byocInfrastructure/{byocInfrastructureId}`

Update configuration of the BYOC infrastructure: rename it, toggle private link and load balancers, or replace its tags. The request is validated as a whole before anything is applied. If applying a field then fails in the data plane, client errors name the fields already applied, while internal errors return a generic message; retrying the same request is safe either way and converges the infrastructure to the requested state. Returns the modified infrastructure

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "displayName": "string",
  "enablePrivateLink": true,
  "gcpPscSubnetId": "string",
  "enablePrivateLoadBalancer": true,
  "enablePublicLoadBalancer": true,
  "tags": {
    "property1": "string",
    "property2": "string"
  }
}
```

<h3 id="update-byoc-infrastructure-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organizationId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the requested organization.|
|byocInfrastructureId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the requested BYOC Infrastructure|
|body|body|[ByocInfrastructurePatchRequest](#schemabyocinfrastructurepatchrequest)|false|none|
|» displayName|body|string|false|Human readable name for infrastructure object|
|» enablePrivateLink|body|boolean|false|Enable or disable private link connectivity on the infrastructure. Disabling is rejected while any service in the organization has active private endpoints|
|» gcpPscSubnetId|body|string|false|GCP BYO-VPC only: customer-provided Private Service Connect NAT subnet name required to enable private link. Only accepted together with `enablePrivateLink: true`|
|» enablePrivateLoadBalancer|body|boolean|false|Enable or disable the private (internal) load balancer of the infrastructure|
|» enablePublicLoadBalancer|body|boolean|false|Enable or disable the public (internet-facing) load balancer of the infrastructure|
|» tags|body|[ByocInfrastructureTags](#schemabyocinfrastructuretags)|false|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "status": 200,
  "requestId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
  "result": {
    "id": "string",
    "state": "infra-ready",
    "accountId": "123456789012",
    "accountName": "string",
    "regionId": "ap-northeast-1",
    "cloudProvider": "gcp",
    "displayName": "string"
  }
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
  "status": 400,

}
```

> 500 Response

```json
}
```

## List of organization notifications

<a id="opIdnotificationGetList"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.clickhouse.cloud/v1/organizations/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/notifications \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/notifications`

**Disclaimer:** This beta endpoint is evolving; the API contract may change. <br /><br /> Returns notifications for the organization, most recent first. Only notifications about resources the caller can access are returned, so two keys in the same organization can see different results. The [notification types endpoint](#tag/Notifications/operation/notificationTypesGetList) lists the types this organization can receive, so it shows what to expect here. Notifications are retained for 180 days. A page holds at most `limit` notifications (default 100, maximum 250; a larger value is clamped) and the server may return fewer. Every response carries `limit` and `nextCursor`; pass `nextCursor` as the `cursor` query parameter to fetch the next page, repeating until it is null.

<h3 id="list-of-organization-notifications-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organizationId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the organization the notifications belong to.|
|limit|query|integer|false|Maximum number of results to return.|
|cursor|query|string|false|Opaque cursor from a previous response's `nextCursor`, marking where to resume the list.|
|severity|query|string|false|Filter to notifications of this severity: 'info', 'warning', 'critical'.|
|type|query|string|false|Filter to notifications of this type. New types are added over time; the [notification types endpoint](#tag/Notifications/operation/notificationTypesGetList) lists the ones this organization can receive.|
|resource_id|query|string|false|Filter to notifications about this resource. A service also matches the notifications of its ClickPipes; pass `resource_type` to narrow to one kind of resource.|
|resource_type|query|string|false|Filter to notifications about resources of this kind. One of 'service', 'organization', 'clickpipe', 'postgres'.|
|from_date|query|string(date-time)|false|Return notifications created at or after this time. An RFC 3339 timestamp, not a bare date.|
|to_date|query|string(date-time)|false|Return notifications created at or before this time. An RFC 3339 timestamp, not a bare date.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "status": 200,
  "requestId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
  "result": [
    {
      "id": "1b7e0a94-2d0f-4c3a-8f1e-6c9b2d5a4e7f",
      "type": "service_backup_failed",
      "severity": "warning",
      "resourceType": "service",
      "resourceId": "string",
      "resourceName": "string",
      "createdAt": "2026-10-07T09:30:00Z",
      "title": "Backup failed for analytics-prod",
      "description": "A scheduled backup for analytics-prod did not complete. Review the backup settings (https://console.clickhouse.cloud/services/abc/backups)."
    }
  ],
  "limit": 0,
  "nextCursor": "string"
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "status": 400,
  "error": "string",
  "requestId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
}
```

> 500 Response

```json
{
  "status": 500,
  "error": "string",
  "requestId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
}
```

## List notification types

<a id="opIdnotificationTypesGetList"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.clickhouse.cloud/v1/organizations/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/notificationTypes \

  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/notificationTypes`

**Disclaimer:** This beta endpoint is evolving; the API contract may change. <br /><br /> Returns every notification type the organization is entitled to, each flagged with whether the caller may use it. Types the organization is not entitled to are omitted; types the caller lacks permission to use are returned with `isAvailable` set to false. Every type supports the `ui`, `email` and `slack` channels, so channels are a property of the API rather than of a type. The effective delivery default is a function of type, role and channel, so no per-type default is reported here.

|organizationId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the requested organization.|

## Get organization usage costs

<a id="opIdusageCostGet"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://api.clickhouse.cloud/v1/organizations/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/usageCost?from_date=1970-01-01&to_date=1970-01-01' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/usageCost`

Returns a grand total and a list of daily, per-entity organization usage cost records for the organization in the queried time period (maximum 31 days). All days in both the request and the response are evaluated based on the UTC timezone.

<h3 id="get-organization-usage-costs-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organizationId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the requested organization.|
|from_date|query|string(date)|true|Start date for the report, e.g. 2024-12-19.|
|to_date|query|string(date)|true|End date (inclusive) for the report, e.g. 2024-12-20. This date cannot be more than 30 days after from_date (for a maximum queried period of 31 days).|
|filter|query|[string]|false|Filter criteria to apply when retrieving the usage cost report. Currently, only filtering by resource tags is supported.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "status": 200,
  "requestId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
  "result": {
    "grandTotalCHC": 0,
    "costs": [
      {
        "dataWarehouseId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
        "serviceId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",

          "backupCHC": 0,
          "computeCHC": 0,
          "dataTransferCHC": 0,
          "initialLoadCHC": 0,
          "publicDataTransferCHC": 0,
          "interRegionTier1DataTransferCHC": 0,
          "interRegionTier2DataTransferCHC": 0,
          "interRegionTier3DataTransferCHC": 0,
          "interRegionTier4DataTransferCHC": 0
        },
        "totalCHC": 0,
        "locked": true
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## Get organization active prepaid balances

<a id="opIdactiveBalancesGet"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.clickhouse.cloud/v1/organizations/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/activeBalances \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/activeBalances`

<aside class="warning">
This operation is deprecated
</aside>

DEPRECATED. Use the `/v1/organizations/{organizationId}/creditBalances` endpoint instead. <br /><br /> Returns the active prepaid credit balances for the organization, each with its own balance ID and remaining credits, along with the total remaining credits across all active balances. A balance is active when it has started, has not expired, and has credits remaining. Balances are ordered by expiration date, soonest first, and the returned page is capped at `limit` (default and maximum 100). When `totalCount` exceeds the number of returned balances, page with `limit`/`offset` to retrieve them all. `totalRemainingPrepaidCredits` always covers every active balance, not just the returned page.

<h3 id="get-organization-active-prepaid-balances-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organizationId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the requested organization.|
|limit|query|integer|false|Maximum number of results to return.|
|offset|query|integer|false|Number of results to skip before returning.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "status": 200,
  "requestId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
  "result": {
    "totalRemainingPrepaidCredits": 0,
    "prepaidBalances": [
      {
        "id": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
        "remainingPrepaidCredits": 0,
        "totalAmount": 0,
        "amountSpent": 0,
        "startDate": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
        "expirationDate": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## Get organization active credit balances

<a id="opIdcreditBalancesGet"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.clickhouse.cloud/v1/organizations/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/creditBalances \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/creditBalances`

**Disclaimer:** This beta endpoint is evolving; the API contract may change. <br /><br /> Returns the active credit balances for the organization, each with its own balance ID, type and remaining credits, along with the total remaining credits across all of them. A balance is active when it has started, has not expired, and has credits remaining. Balances are ordered by expiration date, soonest first. The list is always present and is empty when the organization has no active balances.

<h3 id="get-organization-active-credit-balances-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organizationId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the requested organization.|

`GET /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/serviceProfiles`

Returns the custom instance profiles the organization can use in a region. Pass byoc_id to list the profiles configured for a BYOC infrastructure; the region is then taken from the infrastructure and region_id may be omitted. The list is empty when the organization tier does not include custom hardware profiles.

<h3 id="list-available-service-profiles-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|---|---|---|---|---|
|organizationId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the organization to list available profiles for.|
|region_id|query|string|false|Region to list profiles for, e.g. us-east-1. Required unless byoc_id is set; when both are set it must match the BYOC infrastructure's region.|
|byoc_id|query|string(uuid)|false|ID of the BYOC infrastructure to list profiles for. BYOC profiles are only returned when this is set.|

`POST /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/services`

Creates a new service in the organization, and returns the current service state and a password to access the service. The service is started asynchronously.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "name": "string",
  "provider": "aws",
  "region": "ap-northeast-1",
  "tier": "development",
  "ipAccessList": [
    {

    }
  ],
  "minTotalMemoryGb": 48,
  "maxTotalMemoryGb": 360,
  "autoscalingMode": "vertical",
  "minReplicaMemoryGb": 16,
  "maxReplicaMemoryGb": 120,
  "numReplicas": 3,
  "minReplicas": 1,
  "maxReplicas": 5,
  "idleScaling": true,
  "idleTimeoutMinutes": 0,
  "isReadonly": true,
  "dataWarehouseId": "string",
  "backupId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
  "backupEncryptionConfig": {
    "schema_version": 1,
    "restore_key_pairs": [
      {
        "customer_managed_encryption_key": {
          "aws_kms_key_arn": "arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111122223333:key/1234abcd-12ab-34cd-56ef-1234567890ab"
        },
        "encrypted_dek": "<base64 wrapped data encryption key>"
      }
    ]
  },
  "privateEndpointIds": [
    "string"
  ],
  "privatePreviewTermsChecked": true,
  "releaseChannel": "slow",
  "byocId": "string",
  "hasTransparentDataEncryption": true,
  "endpoints": [
    {
      "protocol": "mysql",
      "enabled": true
    }
  ],
  "profile": "string",
  "complianceType": "hipaa",
  "tags": [
    {
      "key": "Environment",
      "value": "staging"
    }
  ],
  "enableCoreDumps": true
}
```

<h3 id="create-new-service-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organizationId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the organization that will own the service.|
|body|body|[ServicePostRequest](#schemaservicepostrequest)|false|none|
|» name|body|string|true|Name of the service. Alphanumerical string with whitespaces up to 50 characters.|
|» provider|body|string|true|Cloud provider|
|» region|body|string|true|Service region.|
|» tier|body|string|false|**Deprecated.** DEPRECATED for BASIC, SCALE and ENTERPRISE organization tiers. Use `minReplicaMemoryGb`, `maxReplicaMemoryGb`, and `numReplicas` instead. Tier of the service: 'development', 'production'. Production services scale, Development are fixed size. Azure services don't support Development tier|
|» ipAccessList|body|[[IpAccessListEntry](#schemaipaccesslistentry)]|true|List of IP addresses allowed to access the service|
|» minTotalMemoryGb|body|number|false|**Deprecated.** DEPRECATED - inaccurate for services with non-default numbers of replicas. Use `minReplicaMemoryGb` instead. Minimum memory of three workers during auto-scaling in Gb. Available only for 'production' services. Must be a multiple of 12 and greater than or equal to 24. Always absent for horizontal-autoscaling services (replica count is variable).|
|» maxTotalMemoryGb|body|number|false|**Deprecated.** DEPRECATED - inaccurate for services with non-default numbers of replicas. Use `maxReplicaMemoryGb` instead. Maximum memory of three workers during auto-scaling in Gb. Available only for 'production' services. Must be a multiple of 12 and lower than or equal to 360 for non paid services or 1068 for paid services. Always absent for horizontal-autoscaling services (replica count is variable).|
|» autoscalingMode|body|string|false|Autoscaling mode. "vertical" (the default when omitted) runs a fixed replica count while memory scales between minReplicaMemoryGb and maxReplicaMemoryGb; "horizontal" scales the replica count between minReplicas and maxReplicas at a fixed per-replica memory (minReplicaMemoryGb equal to maxReplicaMemoryGb). Horizontal requires the feature to be enabled for the organization.|
|» minReplicaMemoryGb|body|number|false|Minimum total memory of each replica during auto-scaling in Gb. A range in vertical autoscaling; equal to maxReplicaMemoryGb in horizontal (memory is fixed while the replica count scales). Must be a multiple of 4 and greater than or equal to 8.|
|» maxReplicaMemoryGb|body|number|false|Maximum total memory of each replica during auto-scaling in Gb. A range in vertical autoscaling; equal to minReplicaMemoryGb in horizontal (memory is fixed while the replica count scales). Must be a multiple of 4 and lower than or equal to 120* for non paid services or 356* for paid services.* - maximum replica size subject to cloud provider hardware availability in your selected region. |
|» numReplicas|body|integer|false|Fixed replica count for vertical autoscaling (autoscalingMode "vertical" or omitted). Mutually exclusive with minReplicas/maxReplicas.|
|» minReplicas|body|integer|false|Minimum number of replicas. A minReplicas/maxReplicas band scales the replica count in horizontal autoscaling (autoscalingMode "horizontal"). Must be provided together with maxReplicas. Mutually exclusive with numReplicas. Requires horizontal autoscaling to be enabled for the organization, unless autoscalingMode is omitted or "vertical" and minReplicas equals maxReplicas (an equal band is then an accepted vertical fixed count and needs no horizontal entitlement).|
|» maxReplicas|body|integer|false|Maximum number of replicas. A minReplicas/maxReplicas band scales the replica count in horizontal autoscaling (autoscalingMode "horizontal"). Must be provided together with minReplicas. Mutually exclusive with numReplicas. Requires horizontal autoscaling to be enabled for the organization, unless autoscalingMode is omitted or "vertical" and minReplicas equals maxReplicas (an equal band is then an accepted vertical fixed count and needs no horizontal entitlement).|
|» idleScaling|body|boolean|false|When set to true the service is allowed to scale down to zero when idle. True by default.|
|» idleTimeoutMinutes|body|number|false|Set minimum idling timeout (in minutes). Must be >= 5 minutes.|
|» isReadonly|body|boolean|false|True if this service is read-only. It can only be read-only if a dataWarehouseId is provided.|
|» dataWarehouseId|body|string|false|Data warehouse containing this service|
|» backupId|body|string(uuid)|false|Optional backup ID used as an initial state for the new service. When used the region and the tier of the new instance must be the same as the values of the original instance. If the backup is stored in your organization's own bucket, `backupEncryptionConfig` is required; it must be omitted otherwise.|
|» backupEncryptionConfig|body|[BackupEncryptionConfig](#schemabackupencryptionconfig)|false|The `encryption_config.json` stored alongside this backup in your bucket, passed through unchanged. Supply the file contents verbatim rather than constructing this object — its shape is versioned and depends on your cloud provider. See [Export backups to your own cloud account](https://clickhouse.com/docs/cloud/manage/backups/export-backups-to-own-cloud-account) for what it contains.<br><br>Accepted only for organizations enrolled in the private preview, and only when the backup is of a service that has transparent data encryption enabled. Such a restore always produces a service with transparent data encryption enabled, inherited from the source service.|
|» privateEndpointIds|body|[string]|false|**Deprecated.** DEPRECATED. To associate the service with private endpoints, first create the service, then use the `Update Service Basic Details` endpoint with the `privateEndpointIds` field to modify private endpoints.|
|» privatePreviewTermsChecked|body|boolean|false|Accept the private preview terms and conditions. It is only needed when creating the first service in the organization in case of a private preview|
|» releaseChannel|body|string|false|Select fast if you want to get new ClickHouse releases as soon as they are available. You'll get new features faster, but with a higher risk of bugs. Select slow if you would like to defer releases to give yourself more time to test. This feature is only available for production services. default is the regular release channel.|
|» byocId|body|string|false|This is the ID returned after setting up a region for Bring Your Own Cloud (BYOC). When the byocId parameter is specified, the minReplicaMemoryGb and the maxReplicaGb parameters are required too, with values included among the following sizes: 48, 116, 172, 232.|
|» hasTransparentDataEncryption|body|boolean|false|True if the service should have the Transparent Data Encryption (TDE) enabled. TDE is only available for ENTERPRISE organizations tiers and can only be enabled at service creation.|
|» endpoints|body|[[ServiceEndpointChange](#schemaserviceendpointchange)]|false|List of service endpoints to enable or disable|
|» profile|body|string|false|Custom instance profile. Only available for ENTERPRISE and BYOC organization tiers. Standard values: 'v1-default', 'v1-highmem-xs', 'v1-highmem-s', 'v1-highmem-m', 'v1-highmem-l', 'v1-highmem-xl'. BYOC services may instead use a dynamic BYOC profile configured for their infrastructure (e.g. 'v1-standard-byoc-4'); it requires byocId, and minReplicaMemoryGb and maxReplicaMemoryGb must both equal the profile's memory size. Use the serviceProfiles endpoint to list the profiles available to the organization.|
|» complianceType|body|string|false|Type of regulatory compliance for service.|
|» tags|body|[[ResourceTagsV1](#schemaresourcetagsv1)]|false|Tags associated with the service.|
|» enableCoreDumps|body|boolean|false|Enables the underlying infra for collecting core dumps. Default is enabled.|

`PATCH /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/services/{serviceId}`

Updates basic service details like service name or IP access list.

```json
      }

      "string"
    ],
    "remove": [
      "string"
    ]
  },
  "releaseChannel": "slow",
  "endpoints": [
    {
      "protocol": "mysql",
      "enabled": true
    }
  ],
  "transparentDataEncryptionKeyId": "string",
  "tags": {
    "add": [
      {
        "key": "Environment",
        "value": "staging"
      }
    ],
    "remove": [
      {
        "key": "Environment",
        "value": "staging"
      }
    ]
  },
  "enableCoreDumps": true
}
```

<h3 id="update-service-basic-details-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organizationId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the organization that owns the service.|
|serviceId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the service to update.|
|body|body|[ServicePatchRequest](#schemaservicepatchrequest)|false|none|
|» name|body|string|false|Name of the service. Alphanumerical string with whitespaces up to 50 characters.|
|» ipAccessList|body|[IpAccessListPatch](#schemaipaccesslistpatch)|false|none|
|» privateEndpointIds|body|[InstancePrivateEndpointsPatch](#schemainstanceprivateendpointspatch)|false|none|
|» releaseChannel|body|string|false|Select fast if you want to get new ClickHouse releases as soon as they are available. You'll get new features faster, but with a higher risk of bugs. Select slow if you would like to defer releases to give yourself more time to test. This feature is only available for production services. default is the regular release channel. All services in a warehouse share one release channel, so changing it on one service changes it for all of them. Changing it through a secondary service also requires the `control-plane:service:manage` permission on the warehouse's primary service.|
|» endpoints|body|[[ServiceEndpointChange](#schemaserviceendpointchange)]|false|List of service endpoints to change|
|» transparentDataEncryptionKeyId|body|string|false|The id of the key to rotate|
|» tags|body|[InstanceTagsPatch](#schemainstancetagspatch)|false|none|
|» enableCoreDumps|body|boolean|false|If true, the underlying infra is enabled for collecting core dumps.|

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» releaseChannel|slow|
|» releaseChannel|default|
|» releaseChannel|fast|

## Update service state

<a id="opIdinstanceStateUpdate"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.clickhouse.cloud/v1/organizations/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/services/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/state \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d '{
    "command": "start"
  }'
```

`PATCH /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/services/{serviceId}/state`

Starts, stops, or wakes a service. The `start` and `stop` commands require the `control-plane:service:manage` permission on the service. The `awake` command requires only `control-plane:service:view` and applies to an idle service; it does not start a stopped service.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "command": "start"
}
```

|---|---|---|---|---|
|organizationId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the organization that owns the service.|
|serviceId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the service to update state.|
|body|body|[ServiceStatePatchRequest](#schemaservicestatepatchrequest)|false|none|
|» command|body|string|true|Command to change the state: 'start', 'stop', 'awake'.|

## Update service auto scaling settings

<a id="opIdinstanceScalingUpdate"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.clickhouse.cloud/v1/organizations/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/services/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/scaling \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d '{
    "minTotalMemoryGb": 48,
    "maxTotalMemoryGb": 360,
    "numReplicas": 3,
    "idleScaling": true,
    "idleTimeoutMinutes": 0
  }'
```

`PATCH /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/services/{serviceId}/scaling`

<aside class="warning">
This operation is deprecated
</aside>

Updates minimum and maximum total memory limits and idle mode scaling behavior for the service. The memory settings are available only for "production" services and must be a multiple of 12 starting from 24GB. Please contact support to enable adjustment of numReplicas.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "minTotalMemoryGb": 48,
  "maxTotalMemoryGb": 360,
  "numReplicas": 3,
  "idleScaling": true,
  "idleTimeoutMinutes": 0
}
```

<h3 id="update-service-auto-scaling-settings-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organizationId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the organization that owns the service.|
|serviceId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the service to update scaling parameters.|
|body|body|[ServiceScalingPatchRequest](#schemaservicescalingpatchrequest)|false|none|
|» minTotalMemoryGb|body|number|false|**Deprecated.** DEPRECATED - inaccurate for services with non-default numbers of replicas. Use `minReplicaMemoryGb` instead. Minimum memory of three workers during auto-scaling in Gb. Available only for 'production' services. Must be a multiple of 12 and greater than or equal to 24. Always absent for horizontal-autoscaling services (replica count is variable).|
|» maxTotalMemoryGb|body|number|false|**Deprecated.** DEPRECATED - inaccurate for services with non-default numbers of replicas. Use `maxReplicaMemoryGb` instead. Maximum memory of three workers during auto-scaling in Gb. Available only for 'production' services. Must be a multiple of 12 and lower than or equal to 360 for non paid services or 1068 for paid services. Always absent for horizontal-autoscaling services (replica count is variable).|
|» numReplicas|body|integer|false|Number of replicas for the service. The number of replicas must be between 2 and 50 for the first service in a warehouse. Services that are created in an existing warehouse can have a number of replicas as low as 1. Further restrictions may apply based on your organization's tier and its per-warehouse replica limit. It defaults to 1 for the BASIC tier and 3 for the SCALE and ENTERPRISE tiers.|
|» idleScaling|body|boolean|false|When set to true the service is allowed to scale down to zero when idle. True by default.|
|» idleTimeoutMinutes|body|number|false|Set minimum idling timeout (in minutes). Must be >= 5 minutes.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "status": 200,
  "requestId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
```

## Update service auto scaling settings

<a id="opIdinstanceReplicaScalingUpdate"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.clickhouse.cloud/v1/organizations/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/services/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/replicaScaling \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d '{
    "minReplicaMemoryGb": 16,
    "maxReplicaMemoryGb": 120,
    "autoscalingMode": "vertical",
    "numReplicas": 3,
    "minReplicas": 1,
    "maxReplicas": 5,
    "idleScaling": true,
    "idleTimeoutMinutes": 0
  }'
```

`PATCH /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/services/{serviceId}/replicaScaling`

Updates minimum and maximum memory limits per replica and idle mode scaling behavior for the service. Supports both vertical autoscaling (fixed replica count, variable memory) and horizontal autoscaling (variable replica count, fixed memory). The memory settings are available only for "production" services and must be a multiple of 4 starting from 8GB. For vertical autoscaling, please contact support to enable adjustment of numReplicas. For horizontal autoscaling (autoscalingMode "horizontal" with minReplicas/maxReplicas), contact support to enable the feature for your organization.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "minReplicaMemoryGb": 16,
  "maxReplicaMemoryGb": 120,
  "autoscalingMode": "vertical",
  "numReplicas": 3,
  "minReplicas": 1,
  "maxReplicas": 5,
  "idleScaling": true,
  "idleTimeoutMinutes": 0
}
```

<h3 id="update-service-auto-scaling-settings-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organizationId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the organization that owns the service.|
|serviceId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the service to update scaling parameters.|
|body|body|[ServiceReplicaScalingPatchRequest](#schemaservicereplicascalingpatchrequest)|false|none|
|» minReplicaMemoryGb|body|number|false|Minimum auto-scaling memory in Gb for a single replica. Available only for 'production' services. Must be a multiple of 4 and greater than or equal to 8. A range in vertical autoscaling; equal to maxReplicaMemoryGb in horizontal.|
|» maxReplicaMemoryGb|body|number|false|Maximum auto-scaling memory in Gb for a single replica. Available only for 'production' services. Must be a multiple of 4 and lower than or equal to 120 for non paid services or 356 for paid services. A range in vertical autoscaling; equal to minReplicaMemoryGb in horizontal.|
|» autoscalingMode|body|string|false|Target autoscaling mode. Omit to keep the service on its current mode. "vertical" runs a fixed replica count while memory scales between minReplicaMemoryGb and maxReplicaMemoryGb; "horizontal" scales the replica count between minReplicas and maxReplicas at a fixed per-replica memory (minReplicaMemoryGb equal to maxReplicaMemoryGb). Switching to horizontal requires the feature to be enabled for the organization.|
|» numReplicas|body|integer|false|Fixed replica count for vertical autoscaling (autoscalingMode "vertical"). Mutually exclusive with minReplicas/maxReplicas. When switching to vertical (autoscalingMode "vertical") with numReplicas and no memory, the service's stored baseline per-replica memory is kept as the new vertical range. Please contact support to enable adjustment of numReplicas.|
|» minReplicas|body|integer|false|Minimum number of replicas. A minReplicas/maxReplicas band scales the replica count in horizontal autoscaling (autoscalingMode "horizontal"). Must be provided together with maxReplicas. Mutually exclusive with numReplicas. Requires horizontal autoscaling to be enabled for the service, unless autoscalingMode is omitted or "vertical" and minReplicas equals maxReplicas (an equal band is then an accepted vertical fixed count and needs no horizontal entitlement).|
|» maxReplicas|body|integer|false|Maximum number of replicas. A minReplicas/maxReplicas band scales the replica count in horizontal autoscaling (autoscalingMode "horizontal"). Must be provided together with minReplicas. Mutually exclusive with numReplicas. Requires horizontal autoscaling to be enabled for the service, unless autoscalingMode is omitted or "vertical" and minReplicas equals maxReplicas (an equal band is then an accepted vertical fixed count and needs no horizontal entitlement).|
|» idleScaling|body|boolean|false|When set to true the service is allowed to scale down to zero when idle. True by default.|
|» idleTimeoutMinutes|body|number|false|Set minimum idling timeout (in minutes). Must be >= 5 minutes.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» autoscalingMode|vertical|
|» autoscalingMode|horizontal|

```bash
curl https://api.clickhouse.cloud/v1/organizations/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/services/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/password \
```

`PATCH /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/services/{serviceId}/password`

Sets a new password for the service

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "newPasswordHash": "string",
  "newDoubleSha1Hash": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="update-service-password-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organizationId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the organization that owns the service.|
|serviceId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the service to update password.|
|body|body|[ServicePasswordPatchRequest](#schemaservicepasswordpatchrequest)|false|none|
|» newPasswordHash|body|string|false|Optional password hash. Used to avoid password transmission over network. If not provided a new password is generated and is provided in the response. Otherwise this hash is used. Algorithm: echo -n "yourpassword" \| sha256sum \| tr -d '-' \| xxd -r -p \| base64|
|» newDoubleSha1Hash|body|string|false|Optional double SHA1 password hash for MySQL protocol. If newPasswordHash is not provided this key will be ignored and the generated password will be used. Algorithm: echo -n "yourpassword" \| sha1sum \| tr -d '-' \| xxd -r -p \| sha1sum \| tr -d '-'|

## Create or replace service autoscaling schedule

<a id="opIdscalingScheduleUpsert"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.clickhouse.cloud/v1/organizations/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/services/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/scalingSchedule \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d '{
    "entries": [
      {
        "name": "Business hours",
        "weekdays": [
          1,
          2,
          3,
          4,
          5
        ],
        "startHourUtc": 9,
        "endHourUtc": 17,
        "autoscalingMode": "vertical",
        "minReplicaMemoryGb": 16,
        "maxReplicaMemoryGb": 16,
        "numReplicas": 3,
        "minReplicas": 2,
        "maxReplicas": 3,
        "idleScaling": true,
        "idleTimeoutMinutes": 0
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/services/{serviceId}/scalingSchedule`

Creates or fully replaces the autoscaling schedule for a service. Pass an empty `entries` array to clear the schedule — a subsequent GET will return 404, and the response will contain an empty `baseConfig` (all fields absent). The base scaling config (applied when no entry is active) is managed separately via the `replicaScaling` endpoint. Requires the scheduled autoscaling feature to be enabled for the organization.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "entries": [
    {
      "name": "Business hours",
      "weekdays": [
        1,
        2,
        3,
        4,
        5
      ],
      "startHourUtc": 9,
      "endHourUtc": 17,
      "autoscalingMode": "vertical",
      "minReplicaMemoryGb": 16,
      "maxReplicaMemoryGb": 16,
      "numReplicas": 3,
      "minReplicas": 2,
      "maxReplicas": 3,
      "idleScaling": true,
      "idleTimeoutMinutes": 0
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="create-or-replace-service-autoscaling-schedule-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organizationId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the organization that owns the service.|
|serviceId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the service.|
|body|body|[ScalingSchedulePostRequest](#schemascalingschedulepostrequest)|false|none|
|» entries|body|[[ScalingScheduleEntryRequest](#schemascalingscheduleentryrequest)]|true|List of schedule entries. Pass an empty array to clear the schedule.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
  "status": 200,

        ],
        "startHourUtc": 0,
        "endHourUtc": 1,
        "autoscalingMode": "vertical",
        "minReplicaMemoryGb": 0,
        "maxReplicaMemoryGb": 0,
        "minReplicas": 0,
        "maxReplicas": 0,
        "idleScaling": true,
        "idleTimeoutMinutes": 0,

      }
    ],

      "minReplicaMemoryGb": 0,
      "maxReplicaMemoryGb": 0,
```

## Set service upgrade window

<a id="opIdupgradeWindowUpdate"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.clickhouse.cloud/v1/organizations/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/services/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/upgradeWindow \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d '{
    "weekday": 3,
    "startHourUtc": 12
  }'
```

`PUT /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/services/{serviceId}/upgradeWindow`

Creates or fully replaces the upgrade window for a service. The upgrade window currently lasts 6 hours from `startHourUtc`. The upgrade window can only be set on primary services; secondary services inherit the primary service window.

Errors:
- 400: invalid field values (`weekday` not in 0–6, `startHourUtc` not in {0, 6, 12, 18}), or the service is a secondary service.
- 401: missing, invalid, or disabled API key.
- 403: caller lacks `control-plane:service:manage` on the service, or the organization does not have the scheduled upgrades feature enabled.
- 404: service does not exist or is not visible to the caller.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "weekday": 3,
  "startHourUtc": 12
}
```

<h3 id="set-service-upgrade-window-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organizationId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the organization that owns the service.|
|serviceId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the service.|
|body|body|[UpgradeWindowPutRequest](#schemaupgradewindowputrequest)|false|none|
|» weekday|body|integer|true|Day of the week the upgrade window starts. 0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday, …, 6 = Saturday.|
|» startHourUtc|body|integer|true|UTC hour when the upgrade window starts. Must be one of 0, 6, 12, or 18. The upgrade window currently lasts 6 hours from this start time.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» startHourUtc|0|
|» startHourUtc|6|
|» startHourUtc|12|
|» startHourUtc|18|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "status": 200,
  "requestId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
  "result": {
    "weekday": 3,
    "startHourUtc": 12,
    "duration": 6
  }
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "status": 400,
  "error": "string",
  "requestId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
}
```

> 500 Response

```json
  "error": "string",
  "requestId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
}
```

## Delete service upgrade window

<a id="opIdupgradeWindowDelete"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.clickhouse.cloud/v1/organizations/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/services/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/upgradeWindow \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`DELETE /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/services/{serviceId}/upgradeWindow`

Deletes the upgrade window for a service, restoring the default scheduling behaviour. The upgrade window can only be deleted on primary services. Deletion succeeds even if the organization has lost the scheduled upgrades entitlement, so a window can be cleared after entitlement loss.

Errors:
- 400: the service is a secondary service.
- 401: missing, invalid, or disabled API key.
- 403: caller lacks `control-plane:service:manage` on the service.
- 404: service does not exist, is not visible to the caller, or no upgrade window is configured.

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organizationId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the organization that owns the service.|

## Reset ClickHouse setting to default

<a id="opIdserviceClickhouseSettingDelete"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.clickhouse.cloud/v1/organizations/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/services/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/clickhouseSettings/string \

  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`DELETE /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/services/{serviceId}/clickhouseSettings/{settingName}`

**Disclaimer:** This beta endpoint is evolving; the API contract may change. <br /><br /> Removes a previously-configured ClickHouse setting, reverting its effective value to the platform default. Settings under `spec.extraConfig.server.*` (e.g. `keep_alive_timeout`, `shared_merge_tree_disable_merges_and_mutations_assignment`) trigger a ClickHouse server rollout restart; other settings propagate to all replicas after a short delay. Deleting a setting that was never configured is a no-op (200 OK).

|organizationId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the organization that owns the service.|

## List of service snapshots

<a id="opIdsnapshotGetList"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.clickhouse.cloud/v1/organizations/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/services/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/snapshots \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/services/{serviceId}/snapshots`

**This endpoint is in beta.** API contract is stable, and no breaking changes are expected in the future. <br /><br /> Returns a list of snapshots for the service, most recent first. Results are capped at `limit` (default 250) per page; the server may return fewer and caps the value at its own maximum. Every response carries `limit`, `totalCount` and `nextCursor`; pass `nextCursor` as the `cursor` query parameter to fetch the next page, repeating until it is null.

<h3 id="list-of-service-snapshots-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organizationId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the organization that owns the snapshot.|
|serviceId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the service the snapshot was created from.|
|limit|query|integer|false|Maximum number of results to return.|
|cursor|query|string|false|Opaque cursor from a previous response's `nextCursor`, marking where to resume the list.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "status": 200,
  "requestId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
  "result": [
    {
      "id": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
      "status": "done",
      "serviceId": "string",

      "finishedAt": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",

      "type": "full",
      "backupName": "string",
      "bucket": {
        "bucketProvider": "AWS",
        "bucketPath": "string",
        "iamRoleArn": "string",
        "iamRoleSessionName": "string",
        "iamRoleExternalId": "string"
      }
    }
  ],
  "limit": 0,
  "totalCount": 0,
  "nextCursor": "string"
}
```

> 400 Response

```json

  "status": 400,

}
```

## Update service snapshot configuration

<a id="opIdsnapshotConfigurationUpdate"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.clickhouse.cloud/v1/organizations/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/services/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/snapshotConfiguration \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d '{
    "enabled": true,
    "gap": 0,
    "timeFrame": 0
  }'
```

`PATCH /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/services/{serviceId}/snapshotConfiguration`

**This endpoint is in beta.** API contract is stable, and no breaking changes are expected in the future. <br /><br /> Updates the service snapshot configuration. Requires ADMIN auth key role. Enables or disables scheduled snapshots and sets the cadence; when enabled, gap and timeFrame (in minutes) must together be one of the supported (gap, timeFrame) pairs: (30, 1440), (60, 2880). Provide at least one of enabled, gap, timeFrame; omit a field to leave it unchanged (null is not accepted). Enabling snapshots or changing the cadence requires an eligible organization (see the organization's capabilities.snapshots).

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "enabled": true,
  "gap": 0,
  "timeFrame": 0
}
```

<h3 id="update-service-snapshot-configuration-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organizationId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the organization that owns the service.|
|serviceId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the service.|
|body|body|[SnapshotConfigurationPatchRequest](#schemasnapshotconfigurationpatchrequest)|false|none|
|» enabled|body|boolean|false|Whether scheduled snapshots are enabled for the service.|
|» gap|body|number|false|Interval between snapshots, in minutes. Set together with timeFrame; only supported preset pairs are accepted.|
|» timeFrame|body|number|false|Retention window the snapshots cover, in minutes. Set together with gap; only supported preset pairs are accepted.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "status": 200,
  "requestId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
  "result": {
    "enabled": true,
    "gap": 0,
    "timeFrame": 0
  }
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "status": 400,
  "error": "string",
  "requestId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
}
```

```json
}
```

## Get list of keys

<a id="opIdopenapiKeyGetList"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.clickhouse.cloud/v1/organizations/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/keys \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/keys`

Returns a list of keys in the organization, ordered by creation date, oldest first. Results are capped at `limit` (default 250) per page; the server may return fewer and caps the value at its own maximum. Every response carries `limit`, `totalCount` and `nextCursor`; pass `nextCursor` as the `cursor` query parameter to fetch the next page, repeating until it is null.

<h3 id="get-list-of-keys-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organizationId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the requested organization.|
|limit|query|integer|false|Maximum number of results to return.|
|cursor|query|string|false|Opaque cursor from a previous response's `nextCursor`, marking where to resume the list.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "status": 200,
  "requestId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
  "result": [
    {
      "id": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
      "name": "string",
      "state": "enabled",
      "roles": [
        "admin"
      ],
      "assignedRoles": [
        {
          "roleId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
          "roleName": "string",
          "roleType": "system"
        }
      ],
      "keySuffix": "string",
      "createdAt": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "expireAt": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "usedAt": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "ipAccessList": [
        {
          "source": "string",
          "description": "string"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "limit": 0,
  "totalCount": 0,
  "nextCursor": "string"
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "status": 400,
  "error": "string",
  "requestId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
}
```

> 500 Response

```json

  "status": 500,
  "error": "string",
  "requestId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
}
```

|» name|body|string|true|Name of the key.|

|» ipAccessList|body|[[IpAccessListEntry](#schemaipaccesslistentry)]|false|List of IP addresses allowed to access the API using this key|

<aside class="warning">
This operation is deprecated
</aside>

**Deprecated.** This endpoint is disabled on 1 January 2027. It is already disabled for new organizations.

Migrate before then to the service discovery endpoint, `GET /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/prometheus/discovery`. It returns one scrape target per service in the [`http_sd`](https://prometheus.io/docs/prometheus/latest/http_sd/) format, and Prometheus picks up new and deleted services automatically. The [Prometheus integration guide](https://clickhouse.com/docs/integrations/prometheus) has a `prometheus.yml` example.

If you need this endpoint after 1 January 2027, contact ClickHouse support to have it enabled for your organization.

Returns Prometheus metrics for the services in the organization. Only services the API key is authorized to view are included.

## Get Prometheus service discovery targets

<a id="opIdorganizationPrometheusDiscoveryGet"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.clickhouse.cloud/v1/organizations/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/prometheus/discovery \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/prometheus/discovery`

Returns one Prometheus scrape target per service in the organization, in the [HTTP service discovery](https://prometheus.io/docs/prometheus/latest/http_sd/) (`http_sd`) format. Only services the API key is authorized to view are included; services that are being deleted or have been deleted are omitted.

Point an [`http_sd_configs`](https://prometheus.io/docs/prometheus/latest/configuration/configuration/#http_sd_config) job at this endpoint to discover and scrape all services in the organization automatically. Prometheus refreshes the target list on every discovery poll, so newly created and deleted services are picked up without configuration changes.

Filter targets in `relabel_configs` by `__meta_clickhouse_region`, `__meta_clickhouse_provider` or `__meta_clickhouse_tag_<key>`. Invalid label name characters in tag keys become `_`. `__meta_clickhouse_tagpresent_<key>` is `true` for every tag, including tags without a value.

Discovered targets scrape with `filtered_metrics=true` by default; pass `?filtered_metrics=false` to this endpoint to discover unfiltered targets. See the [Prometheus integration guide](https://clickhouse.com/docs/integrations/prometheus) for more on the exported metrics.

<h3 id="get-prometheus-service-discovery-targets-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organizationId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the requested organization.|
|filtered_metrics|query|string(boolean)|false|Whether discovered targets scrape a filtered list of metrics. Sets the filtered_metrics parameter on each discovered target. Defaults to true.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
[
  {
    "targets": [
      "string"
    ],
    "labels": {
      "__scheme__": "string",
      "__metrics_path__": "string",
      "__param_filtered_metrics": "string",
      "clickhouse_org_id": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
      "clickhouse_service_id": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
      "clickhouse_discovery_service_name": "string",
      "__meta_clickhouse_region": "string",
      "__meta_clickhouse_provider": "string",
      "property1": "string",
      "property2": "string"
    }
  }
]
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "status": 400,
  "error": "string",
  "requestId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
}
```

> 500 Response

```json
{
  "status": 500,
  "error": "string",
  "requestId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
}
```

## Get ClickPipes service context

<a id="opIdclickPipesServiceContextGet"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.clickhouse.cloud/v1/organizations/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/services/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/clickpipes/context \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/services/{serviceId}/clickpipes/context`

**This endpoint is in beta.** API contract is stable, and no breaking changes are expected in the future. <br /><br /> Returns service-level ClickPipes capabilities and Private Preview workload identity context, including the GCP service account to grant access to customer source resources.

<h3 id="get-clickpipes-service-context-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organizationId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the organization that owns the service.|
|serviceId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the service to get ClickPipes context for.|

`PUT /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/services/{serviceId}/clickpipes/{clickPipeId}/settings`

Update the advanced settings for the specified ClickPipe. Send key-value pairs where values can be strings, numbers, or booleans.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "streaming_max_insert_wait_ms": 5000,
  "object_storage_concurrency": 1,
  "object_storage_polling_interval_ms": 30000,
  "object_storage_max_insert_bytes": 10737418240,
  "object_storage_max_file_count": 100,
  "clickhouse_max_threads": 8,
  "clickhouse_max_insert_threads": 1,
  "clickhouse_min_insert_block_size_bytes": 1073741824,
  "clickhouse_max_download_threads": 4,
  "clickhouse_parallel_distributed_insert_select": 2,
  "kafka_read_committed": false,
  "object_storage_use_cluster_function": true,
  "clickhouse_parallel_view_processing": false
}
```

<h3 id="update-clickpipe-settings-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organizationId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the organization that owns the service.|
|serviceId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the service that owns the ClickPipe.|
|clickPipeId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the ClickPipe to update settings for.|
|body|body|[ClickPipeSettingsPutRequest](#schemaclickpipesettingsputrequest)|false|none|
|» streaming_max_insert_wait_ms|body|integer|false|Streaming max insert wait time. Configures the max wait period before inserting data into the ClickHouse.|
|» object_storage_concurrency|body|integer|false|Object storage concurrency. Number of concurrent file processing threads|
|» object_storage_polling_interval_ms|body|integer|false|Object storage polling interval. Configures the refresh interval for querying continuous ingest for new object storage data|
|» object_storage_max_insert_bytes|body|integer|false|Max insert bytes. Number of bytes to process in a single insert batch|
|» object_storage_max_file_count|body|integer|false|Max file count. Maximum number of files to process in a single insert batch|
|» clickhouse_max_threads|body|integer|false|Max threads. Maximum number of concurrent threads for file processing|
|» clickhouse_max_insert_threads|body|integer|false|Max insert threads. Maximum number of concurrent insert threads|
|» clickhouse_min_insert_block_size_bytes|body|integer|false|Min insert block size bytes. Minimum size of data block for insert (in bytes)|
|» clickhouse_max_download_threads|body|integer|false|Max download threads. Maximum number of concurrent download threads|
|» clickhouse_parallel_distributed_insert_select|body|integer|false|Parallel distributed insert select. Only applies when object_storage_use_cluster_function is enabled. When disabled, this setting is ignored and the effective value is 0.|
|» kafka_read_committed|body|boolean|false|Kafka Read Committed. Whether Kafka consumers read only committed messages|
|» object_storage_use_cluster_function|body|boolean|false|use cluster function. Whether to use ClickHouse cluster function for distributed processing|
|» clickhouse_parallel_view_processing|body|boolean|false|parallel view processing. Whether to enable pushing to attached views concurrently instead of sequentially|

`POST /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/services/{serviceId}/clickpipes/schemaDiscovery`

**This endpoint is in beta.** API contract is stable, and no breaking changes are expected in the future. <br /><br /> Infers the schema (field names and ClickHouse data types) of a ClickPipe source without creating a pipe. ## Update ClickPipe scaling

<a id="opIdclickPipeScalingUpdate"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.clickhouse.cloud/v1/organizations/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/services/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/clickpipes/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/scaling \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d '{
    "replicas": 1,
    "concurrency": 0,
    "replicaCpuMillicores": 125,
    "replicaMemoryGb": 0.5
  }'
```

`PATCH /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/services/{serviceId}/clickpipes/{clickPipeId}/scaling`

Change scaling settings for the specified ClickPipe. This endpoint supports Kafka, Kinesis, and object storage pipes (S3, GCS, Azure Blob).

**Note:** For database ClickPipes (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, BigQuery), use the [Update CDC ClickPipes scaling](#tag/ClickPipes/operation/clickPipeCdcScalingUpdate) endpoint instead.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "replicas": 1,
  "concurrency": 0,
  "replicaCpuMillicores": 125,
  "replicaMemoryGb": 0.5
}
```

<h3 id="update-clickpipe-scaling-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organizationId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the organization that owns the service.|
|serviceId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the service that owns the ClickPipe.|
|clickPipeId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the ClickPipe to update scaling settings.|
|body|body|[ClickPipeScalingPatchRequest](#schemaclickpipescalingpatchrequest)|false|none|
|» replicas|body|integer|false|Number of replicas to scale to. Use to scale Kafka pipes.|
|» concurrency|body|integer|false|**Deprecated.** Number of concurrency to scale to. Use to scale S3 pipes.|
|» replicaCpuMillicores|body|integer|false|CPU in millicores for each replica. Use to scale streaming pipes.|
|» replicaMemoryGb|body|number|false|Memory in GB for each replica. Use to scale streaming pipes.|

```bash
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d '{
    "command": "start"
  }'
```

`PATCH /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/services/{serviceId}/clickpipes/{clickPipeId}/state`

Start, stop or resync ClickPipe. Stopping a ClickPipe will stop the ingestion process from any state. Starting is allowed for ClickPipes in the "Stopped" state or with a "Failed" state. Resyncing is only for Postgres and MySQL pipes and can be done from any state.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "command": "start"
}
```

<h3 id="update-clickpipe-state-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organizationId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the organization that owns the service.|
|serviceId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the service that owns the ClickPipe.|
|clickPipeId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the ClickPipe to update state.|
|body|body|[ClickPipeStatePatchRequest](#schemaclickpipestatepatchrequest)|false|none|
|» command|body|string|true|Command to change the state: 'start', 'stop', 'resync'.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» command|start|
|» command|stop|
|» command|resync|

## Get CDC ClickPipes scaling

<a id="opIdclickPipeCdcScalingGet"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.clickhouse.cloud/v1/organizations/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/services/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/clickpipesCdcScaling \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}"
```

`GET /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/services/{serviceId}/clickpipesCdcScaling`

Get scaling settings for database ClickPipes (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, BigQuery).

The infrastructure is shared between all database ClickPipes in the service, both for initial load and CDC. For billing purposes, 2 CPU cores and 8 GB of RAM [correspond](https://clickhouse.com/docs/cloud/manage/billing/overview#clickpipes-for-postgres-cdc) to one compute unit.

**Note:** For Kafka, Kinesis, and object storage pipes (S3, GCS, Azure Blob), see [Get ClickPipe](#tag/ClickPipes/operation/clickPipeGet).

**This endpoint becomes available once at least one database ClickPipe was provisioned.**

<h3 id="get-cdc-clickpipes-scaling-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organizationId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the organization that owns the service.|
|serviceId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the service that owns the ClickPipe.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "status": 200,
  "requestId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
  "result": {
    "replicaCpuMillicores": 2000,
    "replicaMemoryGb": 8
  }
}
```

## Update CDC ClickPipes scaling

<a id="opIdclickPipeCdcScalingUpdate"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://api.clickhouse.cloud/v1/organizations/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/services/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/clickpipesCdcScaling \
  -X PATCH \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Basic ${CREDENTIALS}" \
  -d '{
    "replicaCpuMillicores": 2000,
    "replicaMemoryGb": 8
  }'
```

`PATCH /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/services/{serviceId}/clickpipesCdcScaling`

Update scaling settings for database ClickPipes (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, BigQuery).

The infrastructure is shared between all database ClickPipes in the service, both for initial load and CDC. Scaling settings may take a few minutes to fully propagate.

For billing purposes, 2 CPU cores and 8 GB of RAM [correspond](https://clickhouse.com/docs/cloud/manage/billing/overview#clickpipes-for-postgres-cdc) to one compute unit. If your organization tier changes, database ClickPipes will be [rescaled](https://clickhouse.com/docs/cloud/manage/billing/overview#compute) appropriately.

**Note:** For Kafka, Kinesis, and object storage pipes (S3, GCS, Azure Blob), see [Get ClickPipe](#tag/ClickPipes/operation/clickPipeGet).

**This endpoint becomes available once at least one database ClickPipe was provisioned.**

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "replicaCpuMillicores": 2000,
  "replicaMemoryGb": 8
}
```

<h3 id="update-cdc-clickpipes-scaling-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organizationId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the organization that owns the service.|
|serviceId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the service that owns the ClickPipe.|
|body|body|[ClickPipesCdcScalingPatchRequest](#schemaclickpipescdcscalingpatchrequest)|false|none|
|» replicaCpuMillicores|body|integer|false|CPU in millicores for DB ClickPipes.|
|» replicaMemoryGb|body|number|false|Memory in GiB for DB ClickPipes. Must be 4× the CPU core count.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
  "status": 200,
  "requestId": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",

  }
}
```

<h3 id="clickstack-create-dashboard-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organizationId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the organization that owns the service.|
|serviceId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the ClickStack service.|
|body|body|[ClickStackCreateDashboardRequest](#schemaclickstackcreatedashboardrequest)|false|none|
|» name|body|string|true|Dashboard name.|
|» tiles|body|[[ClickStackTileInput](#schemaclickstacktileinput)]|true|List of tiles/charts to include in the dashboard.|
|» tags|body|[string]|false|Tags for organizing and filtering dashboards.|
|» filters|body|[[ClickStackFilterInput](#schemaclickstackfilterinput)]|false|Dropdown filters added to the dashboard. Each one broadcasts its selected value as a condition, acts as a variable which can be referenced in tile queries, or both.|
|» savedQuery|body|string \| null|false|Optional default dashboard query to persist on the dashboard.|
|» savedQueryLanguage|body|string \| null|false|Query language used by savedQuery.|
|» savedFilterValues|body|[[ClickStackSavedFilterValue](#schemaclickstacksavedfiltervalue)]|false|Optional default dashboard filter values to persist on the dashboard.|
|» containers|body|[[ClickStackDashboardContainer](#schemaclickstackdashboardcontainer)]|false|Optional grouping containers. Each tile may join a container via tile.containerId, and a tab inside it via tile.tabId.|

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» savedQueryLanguage|sql|
|» savedQueryLanguage|lucene|

<h3 id="clickstack-update-dashboard-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organizationId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the organization that owns the service.|
|serviceId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the ClickStack service.|
|clickStackDashboardId|path|string|true|ClickStack Dashboard ID|
|body|body|[ClickStackUpdateDashboardRequest](#schemaclickstackupdatedashboardrequest)|false|none|
|» name|body|string|true|Dashboard name.|
|» tiles|body|[[ClickStackTileInput](#schemaclickstacktileinput)]|true|Full list of tiles for the dashboard. Existing tiles are matched by ID; tiles with an ID that does not match an existing tile will be assigned a new generated ID.|
|» tags|body|[string]|false|Tags for organizing and filtering dashboards.|
|» filters|body|[[ClickStackFilter](#schemaclickstackfilter)]|false|Dropdown filters added to the dashboard. Each one broadcasts its selected value as a condition, acts as a variable which can be referenced in tile queries, or both.|
|» savedQuery|body|string \| null|false|Optional default dashboard query to persist on the dashboard.|
|» savedQueryLanguage|body|string \| null|false|Query language used by savedQuery.|
|» savedFilterValues|body|[[ClickStackSavedFilterValue](#schemaclickstacksavedfiltervalue)]|false|Optional default dashboard filter values to persist on the dashboard.|
|» containers|body|[[ClickStackDashboardContainer](#schemaclickstackdashboardcontainer)]|false|Optional grouping containers. Each tile may join a container via tile.containerId, and a tab inside it via tile.tabId.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» savedQueryLanguage|sql|
|» savedQueryLanguage|lucene|

<h3 id="clickstack-validate-dashboard-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|organizationId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the organization that owns the service.|

|body|body|[ClickStackCreateDashboardRequest](#schemaclickstackcreatedashboardrequest)|false|none|
|» name|body|string|true|Dashboard name.|
|» tiles|body|[[ClickStackTileInput](#schemaclickstacktileinput)]|true|List of tiles/charts to include in the dashboard.|
|» tags|body|[string]|false|Tags for organizing and filtering dashboards.|
|» filters|body|[[ClickStackFilterInput](#schemaclickstackfilterinput)]|false|Dropdown filters added to the dashboard. Each one broadcasts its selected value as a condition, acts as a variable which can be referenced in tile queries, or both.|
|» savedQuery|body|string \| null|false|Optional default dashboard query to persist on the dashboard.|
|» savedQueryLanguage|body|string \| null|false|Query language used by savedQuery.|
|» savedFilterValues|body|[[ClickStackSavedFilterValue](#schemaclickstacksavedfiltervalue)]|false|Optional default dashboard filter values to persist on the dashboard.|
|» containers|body|[[ClickStackDashboardContainer](#schemaclickstackdashboardcontainer)]|false|Optional grouping containers. Each tile may join a container via tile.containerId, and a tab inside it via tile.tabId.|

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|

`GET /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/services/{serviceId}/clickstack/alerts`

**This endpoint is in beta.** API contract is stable, and no breaking changes are expected in the future. <br /><br /> ClickStack: Retrieves alerts for the authenticated team (paginated). Results are capped at `limit` (default and maximum 1000). When `totalCount` exceeds the number of returned items, page with `limit`/`offset` to retrieve them all.

<h3 id="clickstack-list-alerts-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|organizationId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the organization that owns the service.|
|serviceId|path|string(uuid)|true|ID of the ClickStack service.|
|limit|query|integer|false|Maximum number of results to return.|
|offset|query|integer|false|Number of results to skip before returning.|
